integrity: Derivation uses the source-defined affine branches and exact Markov partition. Exact rational computations check finite instances only; universal statements rely on the supplied proof. Older related work, including an earlier map with an identical translated Markov tail, is explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: The probability law is for the Ji–Ma auxiliary affine Markov map started uniformly in its fifth cell; the auxiliary map is not semiconjugate to the originating bimodal map. The full joint finite-ceiling transform is the central contribution; Catalan first-passage marginals and geometric Galton–Watson survival scaling are classical or previously established. Critical-window limits hold for fixed strictly positive observation variables. No uniqueness or external validation is claimed.
title: Joint time-and-depth excursions at a countably branched interval-map transition
